entity_note: AWS is a reportable segment of Amazon.com, Inc. It has no separate legal accounts; its revenue is the segment net sales line in the Amazon 10-K.

parent.name: Amazon.com, Inc.
parent.relationship: AWS is one of three reportable segments (North America, International, AWS).

europe.note: Amazon reports AWS as one worldwide segment and gives no geographic split of it. Amazon's own revenue-by-country note covers the retail business, not AWS. Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL (Luxembourg, RCS B186284) has filed accounts since 2016, but its territory is EMEA, including Bahrain, Israel, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates alongside the United Kingdom and Switzerland, and as an intra-group reselling entity its turnover is not comparable with a segment revenue line. There is therefore no AWS figure for Europe that can stand beside the European providers.

notes: Every figure is the segment net sales line taken from the audited 10-K segment note, not from a press release or a summary page.
Each segment table was checked by adding the three segments to the consolidated total; all eleven years reconcile.
AWS 2022 is 80,096, as printed in both the 2022 and 2024 10-K segment notes. A figure of 79,383 appears in the project's earlier working notes; it is not an Amazon figure and should not be used.
No restatement of AWS segment net sales occurred over the window: the 2024 10-K repeats 2022 and 2023 unchanged, and the 2025 10-K repeats 2023 and 2024 unchanged.
FY2026 closes on 31 December 2026, after the compile date.
